subject: 2025-2026 BIOMEDICINE FOR ENGINEERS (17715202)
evaluation_summary: Final grade is a weighted average of 4 partial exams (15% each, 60% total) and 3 tasks (10%, 15%, 15%, 40% total). A minimum of 4/10 in each partial exam and a weighted average of 5/10 are required to pass.

components.name: Partial Exam 1 (Unit 4 - Cellular Biology)
components.details: Synchronous Moodle quiz covering all Unit 4 Cell Biology topics (chemical to cellular level, membranes, organelles, cell functions, histology); opens 17:10 and closes 17:57.

components.name: Partial Exam 2 (Unit 1 - Human Genome)
components.details: Synchronous short-answer exam covering Unit 1 Human Genome except human genetic variation; includes theory and practical exercises using NCBI Gene/Genome and UCSC Genome Browser; camera on, microphone off, AI not allowed.

components.name: Partial Exam 3 (Unit 2 and Unit 3)
components.details: Synchronous short-answer exam covering human genome variation, regulation of gene expression, and human proteome; exact contents to be communicated by the instructor.

components.name: Partial Exam 4 (Unit 5 - Physiology)
components.details: Synchronous Moodle quiz covering Unit 5 Human Anatomy and Physiology (body systems, homeostasis, physiopathology); opens 17:05 and closes 18:00.

components.name: Task 1 (Unit 4 - Cellular Biology)
components.details: Select an organ from the Step 1 choice, fill the histology template, and submit a PDF via Graded Activities by 14 November 2025.

components.name: Task 2 (Unit 1: The human Genome)
components.details: Complete the assignment on the human genome using NCBI Gene/Genome and UCSC Genome Browser; due by 26 November 2025 at 23:59.

components.name: Task 3 (Unit 2 and Unit 3)
components.details: Complete the assignment covering the human proteome and regulation of gene expression; due by 20 January 2026 at 23:59.

evaluation_notes: Weights sum to 100%. Minimum 4/10 in each partial exam and overall weighted average 5/10 are required. Partial exams can be reassessed in January; the dashboard shows reassessment quizzes for Partial Exam 1 and Partial Exam 4 on 2026-01-26, but no dashboard entries for reassessment of Partial Exams 2 and 3. Tasks are continuous assessment and cannot be reassessed. Plagiarism and impersonation are forbidden. The course page lists dashboard quizzes only for Partial Exam 1 (Unit 4) and Partial Exam 4 (Unit 5); Partial Exam 2 and Partial Exam 3 dates come from class announcements. Class 2026-01-08 places the molecular biology exam around 2026-01-22, while the official course page lists Unit 5 Partial Exam 4 on 2026-01-19. The presentation PDF contains older exam dates (e.g. 28 Nov, 23 Jan) that conflict with course page and class announcements.
schedule_notes: Regular weekly slots: Mondays 17:00-18:00 for Cell Biology/Physiology (Lluís Pujadas) and Thursdays 14:00-15:30 for Molecular Biology (Mireia Olivella). Sessions are online synchronous and recorded. No class on Thursday 2025-10-30 (instructor at conference) and apparently no class on Thursday 2025-11-06 (instructor cancelled due unforeseen problem, per class 2025-11-13). Christmas break: no molecular classes between 2025-12-18 and 2026-01-08; no cell biology/physiology classes between 2025-12-15 and 2026-01-12. Some Monday final sessions may run past 18:00; recordings show starts around 17:03-17:15 and the final session lasted 1:12:09.
